categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in polymer complete production process technology services, focusing on high-performance polymer materials including polyamide 6/66 (PA6/PA66), functional polyester (vPET), polycarbonate (PC), polybutylene terephthalate (PBT), recycled polyester (rPET), recycled polyamide (rPA), and bio-based chemical fibers such as Lyocell. It provides integrated turnkey system solutions covering consulting, R&D, manufacturing, construction, integration, and operation management for these materials. Additionally, it offers industrial AI integrated application solutions and engineering services for synthetic fiber production lines.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages proprietary polymerization and spinning technologies, including solid-state polymerization (SSP) ultra-clean technology via its subsidiary Polymetrix, chemical recycling methods for nylon and polyester, and advanced process engineering for high-quality fiber production. It integrates industrial internet and AI technologies into manufacturing processes, developing digital intelligent manufacturing solutions based on 'end-edge-cloud' collaborative computing. The company also pioneers chemical recycling technologies for high-performance fiber recovery and bio-based fiber production.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading synthetic fiber producers, food and beverage companies requiring food-grade packaging materials, and industries such as automotive, aerospace, electronics, textiles, and consumer goods. The company serves both domestic and international markets, with significant projects in China, Europe, the Americas, and Southeast Asia. Its solutions cater to high-end applications in textiles, engineering plastics, packaging, and recycled materials sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with significant business in the East China and North China regions, and substantial overseas operations through its Swiss subsidiary Polymetrix, which serves Europe, the Americas, and Asia-Pacific markets. It has subsidiaries and investments in multiple Chinese provinces and international locations including Switzerland, Luxembourg, and Hong Kong.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the polymer and synthetic fiber supply chain, providing technology, engineering, and integrated solutions for polymer synthesis, fiber production, and recycling processes. It extends its services upstream by investing in key raw material sectors such as caprolactam production, enabling integrated supply chain solutions from raw materials to finished fibers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include advancing high-end polymerization and spinning technologies for nylon 6/66, developing chemical recycling technologies for nylon and polyester to enable closed-loop recycling, expanding bio-based fiber production capabilities (notably Lyocell), and integrating AI and industrial internet technologies for smart manufacturing. The company emphasizes green, low-carbon, and circular economy initiatives aligned with national policies on carbon neutrality and sustainable development.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through engineering service contracts, turnkey project delivery, technology licensing, and integrated system solutions for polymer production and recycling. The company also earns income from industrial AI application solutions and sales of proprietary technology packages. It does not rely on product sales alone but on comprehensive service and technology provision across the polymer production lifecycle.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading domestic and international technology service provider in the synthetic fiber and polymer processing industry, with a strong reputation and extensive patent portfolio. Its subsidiary Polymetrix holds a dominant market share in SSP technology globally, especially in food-grade PET and recycled PET markets. The company competes with international chemical and engineering firms but maintains competitive advantages through proprietary technologies, integrated solutions, and strong customer relationships.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.074 billion, a 14.09% decrease from the previous year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 318.3 million, a 9.64% increase year-over-year. Total assets stood at RMB 3.61 billion, with net assets of RMB 2.59 billion. The company has shown steady profitability growth despite revenue fluctuations, supported by diversified business segments and international expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company offers comprehensive, customized, and technologically advanced polymer production and recycling solutions that integrate proprietary core technologies and engineering expertise. Its unique value lies in delivering high-quality, efficient, and environmentally sustainable process technologies, including ultra-clean SSP and chemical recycling methods, enabling clients to achieve product differentiation, cost reduction, and compliance with stringent environmental standards. The integration of AI and industrial internet solutions further enhances operational efficiency and innovation capacity.
